representation: unchanged 18-bit companded token representation; codebooks fit only on wave+Gray-Scott training mixture
parent_selector: Phase-28 per-trajectory held-out BIC selector between 26-feature and 62-feature libraries, unchanged
new_candidate: 82-feature library = Phase-29 62 features plus 20 within-channel quadratic products among the four parity-odd 3x3 Fourier coordinates
reset_handling: 26/62 parent fitting remains exactly Phase 28. The 82 candidate is fit only on clean decoded transitions t=1->2 through t=6->7; decoded transition t=0->1 is excluded because it contains initial-state RVQ reset correction.
shared_support_rule: For each evaluation split, fit 62 and 82 candidates on clean prefix transitions t=1->2 through t=4->5. Evaluate both on held-out observed transitions t=5->6 and t=6->7. Compute per-trajectory gain = 1 - MSE82/MSE62, then take the batch median. Enable 82 for the entire split iff median gain > 0.10. Otherwise use the unchanged Phase-28 26-vs-62 selector per trajectory. If 82 is enabled, refit 82 on clean transitions t=1->2 through t=6->7 before recursive token rollout.
exploratory_support: Two untouched nonregistered codebook/data draws passed 23/23 each under this exact 0.10 median-gain rule.
seed_convention: Within each replicate: +1 wave_train, +2 gray_train, +3/+4 state codebook seeds, +5/+6 innovation codebook seeds, +11..+13 wave eval, +21..+24 Gray eval, +31..+34 NLS eval, +41..+44 advection eval, +51..+54 Burgers eval, +61..+64 Hamilton-Jacobi eval.
frozen_pass_rule: PASS only if every one of 3 fresh registered replicates beats raw-state persistence on all 23 primary splits: 69/69 cells. Any ratio >= 1.0 is FAIL. No retries or replacement seeds.
claim_limit: Synthetic benchmark evidence only; not unrestricted scientific-law discovery or new physics.
